mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level directly reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline across the economy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals severe labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as corporate earnings face immediate demand contraction pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of UNRATE > 8.0 instances or Rank IC < -0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and industrial production declines signal accelerating economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through dual earnings and sentiment shocks.
failure_condition: Joint UNRATE rise/INDPRO fall fails to predict negative returns in >35% of cases (SPX 20d returns positive >35% of time) or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) create dual headwinds for equities, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through rate hikes and weak labor markets.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles with UNRATE > 5.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive >50% of the time or interaction signal Rank IC < 0.01 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate immediate consumer demand strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as markets react to near-term economic momentum.
failure_condition: HOUST level fails to predict positive 5-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or SPX 5-day returns negative >55% of high HOUST periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 (index) signals manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as supply chain disruptions reduce corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive >45% of INDPRO < 95.0 instances or Rank IC < -0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) growth signal robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through sustained revenue growth momentum.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST/RSAFS rise fails to predict positive returns >65% of time (SPX 20d returns negative >35% of time) or interaction Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 100) indicates strong manufacturing activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as supply chain efficiency supports corporate earnings expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative >40% of INDPRO > 100 instances or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
